intro: Mozambique stretches about 2,500 km along the Indian Ocean.

chapters.title: Coast and rivers
text: The coast has beaches, coral reefs and islands like the Bazaruto Archipelago. The Zambezi and Limpopo rivers cross to the sea, and Lake Malawi forms part of the north-west border. Gorongosa National Park has been restored after the war.

chapters.title: Cyclones
text: Tropical cyclones and floods often hit the coast.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Mozambique's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
